issues.description: Class name mismatch for the concrete animals: the problem statement (UML and tasks) and the template/Main.java expect concrete classes named Seal, Pig, and Goat. The solution repository does not provide implementations in Seal.java, Pig.java, and Goat.java (these files are empty) and instead implements the required behavior in classes named SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat. This naming discrepancy (Seal/Pig/Goat vs SpaceSeal/SpacePig/SpaceGoat) is likely to confuse students: they will look for Seal/Pig/Goat in the reference solution or in tests but find only Space-prefixed classes, making it unclear which classes to implement or use for tests/grading.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the concrete class names consistent across artifacts. Option A (preferred): rename or duplicate the solution classes so that Seal, Pig, and Goat are present and implement the required constructors and methods (e.g., move/rename SpaceSeal -> Seal, SpacePig -> Pig, SpaceGoat -> Goat). Option B: add thin wrapper classes Seal/Pig/Goat in the solution that extend or delegate to the corresponding Space* implementations. Option C: if Space-prefixed names are intentional, update the problem statement and template (and any tests) to reference SpaceSeal/SpacePig/SpaceGoat and document the naming choice. Ensure tests and Main.java use the same class identifiers as the specification.
